description: Missionary's own send, BCC'd to the ingest address, delivered through Cloudflare Email Routing. The authentication reference case: a real Authentication-Results chain over a real DKIM signature.

original.subject: Semana 13 — conferencia de zona y una llanta ponchada

notes: Bcc: post@pdayletters.com is present in this recipient's own copy. Gmail does not strip it, so absence of Bcc proves nothing about how the message was addressed.
Return-Path is SRS-rewritten to SRS0=hf4-=3f=missionary.org=elder.example@pdayletters.com, so the sender's address never appears literally in it.

Header order is ARC(i=3), mx.google.com, ARC(i=2), mx.cloudflare.net, ARC(i=1). Only the mx.cloudflare.net result is trustworthy here; selecting the first Authentication-Results header would read Google's.
